name: pactroom-monorepo
description: PactRoom: Cross-Machine API Contract & Breaking-Change Negotiator for Switch Rooms

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,server,web" -c "blue,green,magenta" "pnpm --filter backend-api dev" "pnpm --filter pactroom-server dev" "pnpm --filter pactroom-web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter contract-engine build && pnpm --filter backend-api build && pnpm --filter pactroom-server build && pnpm --filter pactroom-web build
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules workspaces/*/node_modules apps/*/.next
